description:
[Servers] One server's player graph: 24 hours to 90 days. The data behind the range tabs of the server page's player chart: parallel arrays `labels` (UTC ISO-8601),
`players` (average in each point) and `peak` (highest reading in it). Unlike `/servers/{id}/history` (raw
readings, kept 7 days) the 30- and 90-day ranges come from the per-server hourly rollup, kept 90 days. Also
`peak_players` and `avg_players` over the range. Cached for five minutes. Use 30d/90d for long trends (get_server_player_history keeps 7 days of raw readings).

range.description: `24h` = every poll; `7d` and `30d` = one point per hour; `90d` = one point per day.

name: get_server_player_graph
title: One server's player graph: 24 hours to 90 days
